svg.aria-label: Sezer Uzun (Ceaser), silhouetted against a sunset. Founder of CEDRA Interactive, co-founder of Makine Çeviri and Finetion. Video games: Game Director and Creative Director. Software: full-stack, native C++ and Qt. Localization: founder of Makine Çeviri.
